title: Test whole-string membership
description: You can compare repetition, grouping, and alternatives through the supplied test cases.

steps.description: ab*c repeats b alone. (ab)*c repeats the grouped pair ab.
The remaining patterns choose alternatives or require digits on both sides of a literal dot.
The nested loops visit each pattern and its supplied strings.

steps.question: Can fullmatch accept abcd for the pattern ab|cd?
steps.answer: No. Each alternative consumes only part of abcd.

steps.description: Each output row reports whole-string membership. The displayed abcd row fails, while ab and cd each match.
